review.scope: One final, request-specific confirmation of current Catalog removal; permanently stop future contact and preserve immutable audit and GitHub history.
review.requestQuote: Please confirm when the current public references have been removed.

responseBody: The current DSH STORE Catalog, candidate, and recommendation records for the project have been removed, and this GitHub identity is excluded from future marketplace submissions. A permanent no-further-contact stop is being recorded. The central contact audit retains prior history, and we cannot erase existing GitHub comments or rewrite repository Git history; forks, caches, and copies may remain. This confirms current marketplace removal, not complete historical erasure.
